title: Beast Games Kraken
description: A surreal fantasy scene dominated by a giant purple kraken-like monster with glowing green eyes and dripping tentacles, wearing a 'BEAST GAMES' chain. In the foreground, a woman in a sparkling gold gown holds a golden YouTube Play Button. MrBeast jumps from the monster's tentacle in the upper right while money, YouTube logos, and a crowd swirl in a chaotic vortex around them.
prompt: Surreal chaotic scene featuring a giant purple kraken monster with glowing green eyes wearing a Beast Games chain, its tentacles dripping and wrapping around objects. A glamorous woman in a sparkling gold gown holds a golden YouTube Play Button in the foreground. MrBeast in black t-shirt jumps from a tentacle in mid-air.
